title: Koopman and transfer operator techniques from the perspective of quantum theory
summary: The study of mathematical connections between operator-theoretic formulations of classical dynamics and quantum mechanics began at least as early as the 1930s in work of Koopman and von Neumann and was developed in later decades by many authors, often independently, into a framework now broadly known as Koopman-von Neumann representation of classical dynamics. This article surveys aspects of this framework for measure-preserving ergodic dynamical systems and connects it with recent approximation techniques for Koopman and transfer operators that are amenable to data-driven numerical…
